rationale: [05 - Conversations/home-belajarcarabelajar/2026-09-29 - best-ani-cli-installation-method [ses_f12cc9dc9ffei13Fg940VV7cBU].md:L4426] The patched build lives outside pacman's database, so the revert is a single rm and AUR 5.1.0 stays intact underneath

[05 - Conversations/home-belajarcarabelajar/2026-09-29 - best-ani-cli-installation-method [ses_f12cc9dc9ffei13Fg940VV7cBU].md:L2368] ani-cli's own -U update would overwrite the patched binary with the broken master build

nodes.label: Separate private repository for the fansub collection, wrapper and config
nodes.norm_label: separate private repository for the fansub collection, wrapper and config
rationale: [05 - Conversations/home-belajarcarabelajar/2026-09-29 - best-ani-cli-installation-method [ses_f12cc9dc9ffei13Fg940VV7cBU].md:L28436] Subtitles are copyrighted fansub data that must live in a private repo, since a public clone or fork would expose them to takedown

[05 - Conversations/home-belajarcarabelajar/2026-09-29 - best-ani-cli-installation-method [ses_f12cc9dc9ffei13Fg940VV7cBU].md:L26026] ani-cli is upstream and gets overwritten by yay updates, while the personal collection is a private asset, so mixing them guarantees a conflict on every update

[05 - Conversations/home-belajarcarabelajar/2026-09-29 - best-ani-cli-installation-method [ses_f12cc9dc9ffei13Fg940VV7cBU].md:L26734] The SubDL key stays in a mode-600 file the script reads directly rather than in the environment, because an env value is readable by every child process
